correctness.rationale: The six simple tame branch points give genus four. The four displayed holomorphic differentials are a basis. For every coefficient choice in characteristic two, f=A^2+xB^2 and the Cartier extraction identities give the complete semilinear action. Its rank is exactly two and its stable rank is either zero or two depending only on a3; nilpotence index exactly three follows when a3=0. The parameter locus is reduced and smooth as an open subset of a hyperplane. Independent exact polynomial checks and enumerated finite fields confirm two witnesses without being used as infinite proof.
